why: Instrument defect found while building, before any measured run: the test built its excluded URL by prefixing https://github.com/ to the corpus protocol's first excluded_repos pattern, but the patterns already hold the host and name an organization (github.com/<org>/), so the URL became https://github.com/github.com/<org>, which no pattern matches, and the test could hold under no implementation of the clone rule. The URL is now https://<pattern><repo> (a repository of the excluded organization). The rule checked (an excluded URL is refused and never cloned) is unchanged; nothing is cloned or read.
